description:
Hand priced orders to a person: quotes (quote ids from quote_made_part or quote_shop_order; each goes to its
    shop at the price quoted) and offers ([{"offer", "quantity"}]: stock parts, which Cliff buys from each store for
    them). Returns the url of one page where the person reviews everything, gives where to ship, and buys it all with
    one card: one hold, one charge for what goes ahead. Shops get their orders; Cliff buys the rest and has it shipped
    to them. Give the url to the person; nothing is bought until they approve. A BOM's `checkout` is these arguments.
    note: the handoff to the shops in words, as the person would write the email: what the parts are for, which
    features matter (fits, mating parts), finish, anything a shop would otherwise ask. notes: {part name: text} for
    one part. Both optional; the person can change the note when approving. need_by (YYYY-MM-DD): when the person
    needs the parts; each shop's order is priced at the cheapest speed that makes it, with the shop's rush (next day
    where its card offers it), and the person can change the speed before approving. Needs an API key.
name: start_checkout
